name: MLX

knownPaths.description: The MLX model store: the folder MLX tooling in this home directory keeps its models in. Almost every byte here is a downloaded model file — the multi-gigabyte weights that language and vision models are made of. It also holds a small server script and its Python environment, which together take a few megabytes, so look at the contents before removing the folder as a whole. Removing the models means downloading them again.
